releases.name: Nano Reef
releases.summary: Turn every keystroke into a thriving ocean! Nano Reef is a cozy companion game where typing or clicking earns gold—without interrupting your work. Spend gold to buy marine fish, vibrant corals, and decorations, or feed your fish to interact. Build your unique, relaxing desktop aquarium!

releases.name: Skate Anywhere
releases.summary:
Skate Anywhere is a tabletop skateboarding game built for mixed reality on Meta Quest 3 and Quest 3S. Your desk becomes a skatepark, your floor becomes a plaza, and the stuff around you becomes your obstacles.

Place a miniature spot on your table and ride it: Brooklyn plazas, skate parks,  a backyard pool, rooftops, a parking garage, an airport baggage claim with moving carousels, a snowy Christmas lot and more.

Ollies, flip tricks, grabs, grinds, manuals, stalls and wall rides, all chained into combos. Easy to pick up, with plenty to master.

releases.name: Point Nemo
releases.summary: You're a commercial diver left under an offshore platform after an accident. The only way up is a chain of emergency refuges, and each one needs a part from out in the dark. You get a bearing, six strobes and a few minutes of gas. Your supervisor, Mara, stays on the radio.

releases.name: Deck Breaker - A Roguelike Deckbuilder
releases.summary: Build a binder of golden cards and carry it across a connected roguelike adventure. Choose a hero, collect and upgrade cards, battle monsters, explore dungeons, and discover how familiar cards transform in each new challenge.

releases.name: Pending Review
releases.summary: Every applicant needs the money. Most of them are lying. Find it in the paperwork, stamp APPROVE or REJECT, call the next one in. The rules change every morning and nobody explains why. You are reviewing them. Somebody upstairs is reviewing you.

releases.name: DATAWANDER
releases.summary: Embark on a surreal exploration of a digital island. Explore a silent virtual world and discover never-before-seen moments of transformation and hidden paths.

releases.name: Arcane Dash - A Pixel Adventure
releases.summary: Relive the past with Arcane Dash - A Pixel Adventure! You are Ilenor the Brave, who has had 4 precious items stolen from him (including his cat, Shadowtongue!), and it's up to you to help him get them back by guiding him through 36 levels of pure chaos, filled with various enemies and deathtraps!

releases.name: That's My Life
releases.summary: That's My Life is a deep life simulation sandbox where multiple systems connect inside one persistent world. Build a career, study, run businesses, invest, own property, form relationships, enter politics or crime, and live with the consequences as every part of your life affects the others.

releases.name: Crossroad Chaos
releases.summary: Take control of this chaotic intersection in this fast-paced traffic management game. Manage traffic lights, impatient drivers, and increasingly chaotic intersections to get everyone through safely.

releases.name: Chisel Me This
releases.summary: Chisel Me This is a 1-8 player party game where you and your friends compete to create statues of various prompts. Sculpt large marble blocks, mold clay, and sabotage competitors as you create artistic masterpieces!

releases.name: When Ren Ran
releases.summary: Ren put on a mask he found — and turned into a spirit. Now he must figure out what the local spirits want and help them to become human again. A bright fairy-tale point-and-click puzzle game, entirely handcrafted by a family of two.

releases.name: How Many Tickets Does It Take To Win The Lottery?
releases.summary: An incremental about one simple question. How many tickets does it take to win the lottery? Scratch tickets, match the numbers and spend your winnings on more tickets, until you are scratching millions at a time. The jackpot odds are realistic, 1 in 290,472,336, and nothing you buy changes it.

releases.name: Code Market
releases.summary: Your store. Your robot. Your code. Code Market is a relaxed management game where you don't click to sell — you program. A robot works in your supermarket, and it does exactly what your Java code tells it: walk to a rack, pick up tomatoes, take a customer's order, pack the bag.

releases.name: Cruisopolis: Cruise Line Tycoon
releases.summary: Build your own cruise line, from a little Rhine river boat to a 5,000-guest megaship. Design every deck, hire the crew, wire the power and plumbing, plan the voyages and keep thousands of guests fed, rested and happy - while the weather, the sea and your own floor plans do their best to stop you.

releases.name: Home Sweet Bunker: Bunker Tycoon
releases.summary: A darkly funny bunker management sim. Build down, admit survivors at the gate and pray none of them is infected. Every night something new tests your layout: diggers from below, crawlers in the vents, spores in the air, screamers drawn to your generators.

releases.name: Jyoka -Castle town-
releases.summary: "Jyoka" is a castle town-building strategy game set in 16th-century Japan. Players select a territory from the map of Japan, hire retainers, gather local resources, and construct various buildings. The game also features defensive battles to protect the castle and sieges to attack enemy strongholds.

releases.name: The Midnight Client
releases.summary: Run a late-night cafe in Tokyo, serve meals tailored to your regulars, and investigate the secrets behind their requests. Balance supplies, cooking and income with clues, conversations and relationships in this 2D single-player narrative adventure and management game.

releases.name: Tomo-chan's Cleaning Panic
releases.summary: This is a fixed-screen action game reminiscent of 80s arcade titles. Use various items to clean floors and pick up trash—all while dodging rats and cockroaches—to tidy up the building within the time limit. The game features 30 levels in total and includes multiple endings

releases.name: Impression Cabinet
releases.summary: Assemble a curated collection of archival images and designed prints. Sort and rotate pieces across the table, reveal finished interpretations, inspect selected prints in Second Look, and file your work into the Cabinet.

releases.name: HauntedHouseNO14
releases.summary: HauntedHouseNO14 is a first‑person psychological horror game offering an immersive terrifying experience. Investigate an old unsolved case, encounter all sorts of uncanny and bizarre occurrences, and gradually unearth the dark truth that has been covered up.

releases.name: Dungeonbound
releases.summary: Dungeonbound is a retro first-person auto-battler dungeon crawler. Send your Warrior, Mage or Rogue into monster-packed depths, watch battles play out turn by turn, and grow stronger every run. Death just sends you home with the loot. Merge gear, buy upgrades, descend again.

releases.name: FOG (Nafuboay)
releases.summary: FOG is a role-playing game centered on combat and character progression, incorporating elements such as Minesweeper. It features mechanics like chain fog-clearing, allowing even newcomers unfamiliar with traditional Minesweeper rules to pick it up quickly.

releases.name: Don't Drop!!
releases.summary: “Don't Drop!!” is a challenging 3D action game that captures the essence of platformers. Control the ball using only jump commands as you aim for the top of the tower! Go through repeated trial and error, and experience the thrill of gradually clearing each level!

releases.name: Wuxiang Lake
releases.summary: Click on 'Start Game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen.Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small fragments move to the correct position

releases.name: War Tiles: Napoleons Invasion of Russia
releases.summary: SUMMER 1812, WITH EUROPE UNDER HIS HEAL AND BRITAIN NOT ACCEPTING ANY PEACE. NAPOLEON LEADS THE LARGEST ARMY EVER ASSEMBLED IN EUROPE. TO FINALY INVADE RUSSIA, CAN YOU QUICKLY CONQUER RUSSIA. WHILE MAKING SURE YOUR TROOPS KEEP UP THE PACE AND ARE SUPPLIED! BEFORE THE RUSSIAN WINTER?

releases.name: Snake Echos
releases.summary: Totally addictive classic card game, how far can you go?WHAT IS HIGHER OR LOWER?Higher or Lower is a classic card game for all your iOS devices. Simply guess whether the next card is higher or lower and see how far you can get. You have 3 lives and unlimited cards. How do you compare to the rest of the world?FEATURES? Game Center integration? Worldwide leaderboards and achievements? See how you compare to your friends? Gorgeous retina graphics for both iPhone and iPadCOMING SOON? More languagesAny comments, problems or feature requests tweet us at http://twitter.com/tapboxltd

releases.name: Blind Katana: The Ember Keeper
releases.summary: Samurai action as a blind swordsman who sees by sound. In the [Eternal Night], enemy footsteps become waves of light that reveal where they are. Read the dark, slash, guard, roll and execute foes. Pick a card each stage to build your swordplay, and face the [Darkest Hour], who stole the [Ember].

releases.name: A Heart-Stirring Date by Victoria Harbour: New Year's Eve at the Turn of the Millennium
releases.summary: 这是一款 AI互动恋爱 + 港片商战悬疑影游。在千禧前夜的香港，你将扮演李洋，爱情拉扯、家族博弈与真相交织，她们不是等待被攻略的角色，而是拥有各自立场、伤口与命运的人。你要做的不只是选择所爱， 时代潮水来临前，你会做出怎样的选择?

releases.name: The Inkwright
releases.summary: An ink-wash xianxia action game. You are your sect's most worthless disciple — spirit energy leaks right out of you. Then you learn the one technique only you can use: clash blades at the instant steel meets steel and take your enemy's power. Every win becomes a unique ink painting.

releases.name: Beast & Bloom: Tower Defense
releases.summary: Beast & Bloom blends maze-building tower defense, random recruitment, and three-way fusion. Recruit adorable guardians, shape enemy paths, and fuse powerful allies. Use magical items to turn obstacles into guardians and grant anti-air powers. Defend your forest against ground and flying foes!

releases.name: Berry Busy Tidy Up!
releases.summary: Thousands of fruit lie scattered across a sunny terraced market. Pick them up, carry them to the right stall and set each one into neat, satisfying rows. No timer, no fail state: just you, 4,000+ pieces of fruit and the quiet joy of putting everything in its place.

releases.name: Grand Space Game
releases.summary: A whacky physics action game about space! In Grand Space Game, take control of a problematic planet that has attracted the attention of many across the cosmos. Smash your way through the galaxy and form objects from the dust for more chaos. Take what you earned and build a new galaxy in your image.

releases.name: The Lost Pit
releases.summary:
Embark on a perilous adventure deep in the heart of a wild forest. Run along ancient trails, cross crocodile-infested lakes, dodge underground scorpions, avoid venomous snakes, and swing across vines with perfectly timed jumps.

Put your reflexes to the test in a journey that demands skill and courage. Every obstacle you overcome brings you one step closer to proving you're a true explorer.

Can you survive the dangers of the jungle, collect the treasures, and complete the expedition before time runs out?

releases.name: Fruit Kombat
releases.summary: The viral brain-rot fruit novela, now a chaotic 3D fighting game. Live the soap-opera betrayals and the reveals nobody asked for while fruit brawlers settle it in the gym. Farm aura to unleash weapon ultimates, in offline duels and online PvP.

releases.name: Civilization integration
releases.summary: A history-driven merge puzzler. Water meets fire and becomes steam; steam pushes the first machine — 223 elements, 10 Chinese dynasties, 74 levels, from a Stone Age campfire to a Qing-era firearms workshop. Every invention cites a real source.

releases.name: Sloppy Forgeries
releases.summary: Sloppy Forgeries is a fast-paced competitive painting game. Practice your skills by butchering iconic masterpieces in one of the few drawing games that measures accuracy pixel-by-pixel in real-time.

releases.name: Green Again
releases.summary: Make the planet Green Again in this relaxing colony sim game! Help a nation of little plant people reclaim their planet taken over by defective robots, as you build, decorate, and defend your settlement. Grow crops for your citizens, explore the unknown, and protect the new natural order!

releases.name: DERELIKT
releases.summary:
Inspired by the mood and structure of System Shock 2, Alien Resurrection, Doom 3, and, DERELIKT leans into the dread of being under-equipped, out of your depth, and very far from help.

Von Neumann Outpost is a remote research station built into a derelict asteroid in Saturn’s orbit. Now its halls are dark, its systems are failing, and the few survivors left inside aren't telling the same story.

Explore the outpost’s secrets, its corridors, labs, maintenance shafts, and crew quarters. And venture deeper into stranger places inside the rock. Search for supplies, solve environmental puzzles, and unlock new routes through a station that grows more dangerous the deeper you go.

releases.name: Mellings
releases.summary: Mellings are striking back! Control an excavator and grab resources to bring them back to the burrow, defend yourself with various cannons while harvesting, and destroy huge buildings and bosses!

releases.name: Astral Hunter: Homebound
releases.summary: A top-down action roguelite where you capture pets and battle alien hordes. Choose your weapons and combine upgrades and items to create your own combat style. Capture alien creatures to use their abilities or bring them to your base for materials. Recruit new characters and conquer the planet!

releases.name: Little Elementals
releases.summary: A chaotic escape of little elementals who want to become human! The Fire Elemental and the Water Elemental secretly visit the human world…but get caught and thrown into prison! Who came to rescue them? Can they escape and reach the human world? Join the little elementals on their adventure!

releases.name: Beyond The Mist: Beginnings
releases.summary: A romance-driven narrative about destiny, devotion, and the dangerous pull of belonging, set against the ruins of a long‑lost city calling you home.

releases.name: Brick Mayhem
releases.summary: Brick Mayhem is a chaotic and funny autobattler where tiny plastic warriors fight, break apart, and destroy everything around them. Customize your characters, build ridiculous battles, and enjoy physics-driven mayhem.

releases.name: Feypath
releases.summary: Feypath is a single button precision platformer that is suitable for those that like punishing but fair gameplay. Save the princess and uncover the secrets of the Demon Kingdom by jumping to the top of the world!

releases.name: Monster Girls Dice Board
releases.summary: On the mysterious Mysteria Island, embark on an exciting dice adventure with charming and unique monster girls! Use strategic board game mechanics to collect resources, buy lands, and compete in friendly matches while building heartwarming bonds and exploring the fantastical island together!
